intro: Jamaica has about 2.8 million people, mostly of African descent.

chapters.title: People
text: English is official, and Jamaican Patois is spoken by almost everyone. Christianity is the main faith; Rastafari began here in the 1930s. The national motto is 'Out of Many, One People'.

chapters.title: Kingston
text: Kingston, the capital, is the birthplace of reggae and dancehall.

keyTerms.meaning: A religion that began in Jamaica.
